summary: NativeBackend(SpecBackend) over Postgres: all 26 abstract methods implemented with parametrized asyncpg queries. Tenant isolation via project_id on every query (board_id->projects.project_id). Optimistic concurrency [AC-03]: version bumped on every UPDATE; expected_version passed via meta['expected_version'] (keeps ABC signatures frozen), guarded UPDATE raises StaleVersionError on mismatch leaving row unchanged. JSONB labels/meta via json.dumps + $n::jsonb on write, json.loads on read. DSN never accepted by constructor (FRONTIER 2). Round-trip verified vs dev DB; ruff+mypy clean.

Parametrized conformance suite (11 contract tests x freeform+native = 22) + 2 native-only tests (optimistic version increment + 50-op concurrency with pg_stat_activity leak check). 24 passed against live dev DB. ruff check + format clean. No DB rows leaked. No NativeBackend bugs found.
